name: XLA_SRC_TRX_SPLIT_DETAILS
description: This table contains the association between the Accounting Hub transaction data file, original transaction number and the system-generated transaction number when the source data splitting option is enabled.

columns.name: ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the subledger transaction associated with the accounting entry.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the subledger application for which the accounting entry is created.

columns.name: FILE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the incoming Accounting Hub transaction data file.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the ledger for which the accounting entry is created.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_TRANSACTION_NUMBER
columns.description: Original transaction number from the Accounting Hub transaction data file.

columns.name: SYSTEM_TRANSACTION_NUMBER
columns.description: Transaction number of the transaction created by the system.

columns.name: PROCESS_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Store the status of the transaction in its life cycle till posting to general ledger. Possible values can be New, Accounted, Posted.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PARTITION_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Partition grouping information, which when combined with the period, determines the database partition in which the transaction will be stored.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Period name corresponding to the transaction date. It's used only for archive and purge process. It may not be the same as the accounting entry period name for this transaction.
